text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something changes for Rice Shower after
the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: H-hey! You're Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep! Y-yes, I am!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Don't be nervous! We just want to say
you were
amazing at the Kikuka Sho the
other day!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I got goosebumps watching
you race
against Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! And she was soooo cool! Her
face was so
intense!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Bourbon is super fast... And really
cool!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's why you can't give up, Rice! We'll
be
cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Brother?!
choice_data_list: It's nice having people cheer for you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-it's not like that... They just wanted to
talk to
me about Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the crowd at the Kikuka Sho
was
cheering for her, so—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Agh... D-don't flatter me that much...
choice_data_list: Because you were there as my rival, too.
Because you were there as my rival, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Agh... D-don't flatter me that much...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...But her rival, huh? Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, we get a glimpse of the other
side of
the coin the next day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whisper, whisper...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Stay back!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: It looks like it's getting to her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it would get to me too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Just look what happened to
Bourbon—she's
always in perfect form,
but right after racing with
Rice Shower...
Well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sob... Wh-why... why does this always happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Why do I always bring misfortune to the
people
around me? Why do I always
cause trouble?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Stay back! You'll just get hurt if you
come close
to me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how hard she trained,
Bourbon has
never been injured... Until...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's all my fault... It happened because
she
became rivals with me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of an Umamusume's
career
are life-changing… and I've
ruined it for her
during the most
important time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...She doesn't have to. After all, I—
choice_data_list: Did you hear that directly from her?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait!
choice_data_list: You didn't hear about it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is no problem. I have become
accustomed to
having visitors wish me
well recently.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry to bother you out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now, please state your objective.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to apologize. I'm sorry... I'm so
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's... my fault that you got hurt! I've
ruined this
important time for you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Why are you apologizing? My data
indicates you
have nothing to do with
the cause of my injury.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-but... you'd never been injured until
you
became my rival!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your reasoning is insufficient. My
probability of
injury has remained
consistent. Conclusion—your
theory is
virtually groundless.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you insist that you possess the ability
to
summon misfortune, then I shall test
the
hypothesis using myself as subject.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...You want to test it on yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Correct. I have acknowledged you as my
rival.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I sensed your potential for growth at the
Kikuka
Sho. I have counted on it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I predicted that if you were to become
my rival, I
would also grow even
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I also predicted the possibility of a
so-called
miracle—that you and I might
one day run the
ultimate race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If my poor luck has anything to do with
you, Rice,
then surely that race will
never occur.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Will you bring me misfortune? Or will
you perform
a miracle with me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower is unable to answer,
Bourbon's words
shaking her to her very
core.
